{{Quote|Her grandfather was in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force, back when they first made their treaty with the Sith. His team was assigned to get some extra collateral, in case the relationship went sour.|[[Pova]]|<ref name="Chasing Copero" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]'s [[Inrokini family]] was the '''grandfather''' of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]]. Zenta's grandfather served in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Chiss–Imperial treaty|treaty]]<ref name="Chasing Copero" /> between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Chiss Ascendancy during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Chiss Ascendancy">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chiss Ascendancy}}</ref>
